activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet
narrative: An employee slipped off a wet metal roof and fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion and his face was fractured on the right side. The employee was not tied off at the time of the fall.

activity_if_known: Indirect exposure to electricity, unspecified
narrative: An employee was welding clips onto the end of the bridging of a wall, then installing bolts through the clips to the wall. As the employee lowered his rod holder down into the lift basket, the rod contacted the basket and energized it. As the employee leaned forward, they contacted the basket and grounded joist, resulting in first- and second-degree electrical burns to the stomach, back, and arms.

activity_if_known: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue
narrative: An employee was transferring glacial acrylic acid when he noticed a small leak originating at the connection between the feeding vessel and transfer hose. When the employee disconnected the transfer hose to troubleshoot the small leak, residual product in the hose splashed onto the employee. He sustained burns to the face and forearm.

activity_if_known: Contact with hot objects or substances
narrative: An employee was responding to an active leak in an apartment unit at around 18:00 hours. He was working on the water heater and tightened the top element. Pressure and hot water starting to spill out and burned both his hands, his right ankle, and his lower right leg.

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level resulting from exposure or contact  unspecified
narrative: An employee was troubleshooting the control setup for a variable air volume box above a ceiling. The employee's hand came into contact with an exposed, energized 277-volt wire that had loosened from its terminal on the box's assembly. He was shocked and fell off a ladder. His left hand passed across the ceiling grid and was lacerated. He also suffered an electrical burn to the right hand and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway incident involving motorized land vehicle  unspecified
narrative: An employee was on an order picker while pulling orders when their right foot got caught between the order picker and a merchandise float, resulting in a crush injury.

activity_if_known: Struck by other falling powered vehicle
narrative: An employee was under a bus performing maintenance when the bus fell on and pinned the employee, breaking bones in the employee's chest and requiring hospitalization.

activity_if_known: Part of occupant s body caught between vehicle and other object in nonroadway transport incident
narrative: On March 17, 2023, an employee was operating a forklift in a production area. As he backed up the forklift, it struck an oil tank. His right hand was caught between the tank and a vertical rail on the forklift, and his right ring and middle fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.

activity_if_known: Thrown, fell, or jumped from animal transportation
narrative: An employee was riding a horse when they fell off the horse, resulting in three broken ribs and a broken clavicle and scapula.

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was pushing a container to the end of a flatbed truck's bed. A forklift pushed a container while it was lifting another container from the truck's bed. The employee's right ankle got caught between two containers on the flatbed and was fractured.

activity_if_known: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.
narrative: A warehouse employee was moving equipment using a dolly and was loading a filler machine when it fell off the dolly onto his left leg. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level while climbing stairs, steps, or curbs
narrative: An employee was up on the deck of the plasma cutter to operate the panel control box when he tripped falling forward onto the surface of the plasma table. He tried to break his fall with his right hand and broke his right wrist.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening, unspecified
narrative: An employee was conducting form work when he fell into an unguarded hole, suffering fractures and a concussion.

activity_if_known: Fall onto or against object on same level, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was completing a fluid treatment process. The employee had just closed a 4-inch valve on a "T" manifold when he tripped and fell forward, striking the shin of his right leg against a valve handle and then landing on the ground. The employee's right leg sustained a spiral fracture requiring hospitalization and surgery.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 21 to 25 feet
narrative: An employee was removing debris and plywood from the catch plank on a bridge deck. The employee stepped on a piece of catch plank that was cracked and fell 21 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken left arm and broken right shin.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling part of powered vehicle still attached
narrative: An employee was waiting to pull product from a pallet inverter machine to load the product into a wrap machine for storage. A second employee was operating a forklift to pull the product from the machine. The second employee lowered the forklift bucket, and the first employee stepped in front of the pallet of product and was struck by the forklift's right fork. He fell to the ground, sustaining a laceration to his left foot and a broken heel.
